Actually earlier git status showed `M  src/command_validate.cc` — staged modification. That suggests maybe the index already differs from HEAD for command_validate. Perhaps the starting tree had staged changes? But then my edits to other files should still show unstaged M. Unless skip-worktree is set.

Let me check git ls-files -v and git diff.
